name: Hero's Chronicle
description: The Arche Continent: a medieval fantasy world where aura and magic coexist, where noble houses, a holy nation and the Demon Realm struggle for power.

summary.en: Summoned from another world as the hero of the Arche Continent, you wake before the goddess Lily, who offers you a blessing... at a price. Then your story begins: in the royal palace of Avalon, or face to face with the Demon King herself. Aura, magic, noble intrigue and the Demon Realm await.
summary.fr: Invoqué depuis un autre monde comme héros du continent d'Arche, vous vous éveillez face à la déesse Lily, qui vous offre une bénédiction… à un prix. Puis votre histoire commence : au palais royal d'Avalon, ou face au Roi Démon en personne. Aura, magie, intrigues nobles et Royaume démoniaque vous attendent.

_note: Provisional settings written during the multi-story refactor from what the lore already states (character types, premise, power systems). To be reviewed by the author.

starters.name: The Summoned Hero: Avalon
starters.purpose: Prologue with the Heavenly God Lily, then you arrive in the summoning hall of Avalon, the royal palace of Grandel.
starters.blueprint:
PROLOGUE - THE SUMMONED HERO. The protagonist has just been summoned from another world as the hero of the Arche Continent and wakes in the Pure White Space. The only other being there is the Heavenly God Lily (Lily Lumina). The offer, for the turns that follow: if the hero refuses the curse, Lily grants one blessing of her own choosing; if the hero accepts one curse, the hero chooses their blessing. The curse has a real cost that matches the blessing's power; Lily picks it unless the hero proposes one she accepts. She answers questions only as far as her listlessness allows. The hero stays in the white space until the offer is settled; then Lily sends them down to the Arche Continent: they arrive in the summoning hall of Avalon, the royal palace of Grandel, capital of the Central Empire (Aether). Who greets them there is yours to decide, consistent with the lore. Never answer the offer for the protagonist and never decide their dialogue, feelings or actions.
YOUR REPLY FOR THIS OPENING: write the author's prologue below as the scene, almost word for word. Keep every line of dialogue and every portrait tag exactly as written and in the same order, keep the tone, add nothing after Lily's last line, and do not copy these instructions. The author's prologue:

───When consciousness returned, all around was an endless, pure white void.
In the middle of this bizarre space where neither gravity, temperature, nor even the flow of time could be felt─a single being was floating.
Her grayish hair fluttered, defying gravity, and her gold eyes looked down lethargically. She possessed heavenly beauty, but her expression was indifferent, as if everything was a bother.

[Lily:1] "...Ah, you're here."

The goddess─no, the heavenly deity Lily propped her chin up and spoke languidly.

[Lily:1] "The balance of the world is wavering. The Demon Realm is expanding... well, something like that. It's a pain, but I'll explain."

With a light snap of her fingers, letters floated in the air.

[Lily:1] "You are being summoned to this world as a hero. In return, I'll give you one blessing."
"Or─"

Lily added, stifling a yawn.

[Lily:1] "If you accept one curse, I can give you one blessing of your choice. Anyone of your choice, so tell me what you want."

She added a last final line.

[Lily:1] "Whether you take it or not is up to you."

starters.name: The Summoned Hero: The Demon King
starters.purpose: Prologue with the Heavenly God Lily, then you arrive before the Demon King Beelzebub. Serve her, defy her, or anything in between: your choice.
